authorization.temporal_order: The sampled producer, record, and regenerating checker belong to a commit after this preregistration is merged.

system.label: linear BeH2 STO-3G CAS(4e,4o)
system.identity_treatment: analytic exact value one; zero shots and zero confidence radius

comparison.question: Does the fixed fully commuting endpoint materially reduce certified leading shot cost relative to QWC on the same BeH2/JW word universe and Ritz functional?
comparison.fixed_grouping: largest-conflict-degree greedy coloring under dyadic block commutativity
comparison.fixed_synthesis: block-local Clifford diagonalizer; reduced circuit is both sampled and priced; exact signed Z-parity readouts

protocol.primary_estimand: first-order Ritz energy functional B'(H-E)B about the exact retained five-vector pencil
protocol.pooled_estimator_role: mandatory covariance regression only; it cannot determine the headline shot-cost verdict

allocator.name: coefficient_range_neyman
allocator.group_score: L_g = sum of absolute Ritz coefficients assigned to setting g
allocator.allocation_rule: two shots per compiled setting, then largest-remainder apportionment of the remaining total physical-shot budget proportional to L_g; zero-score settings receive only the two-shot floor

confidence.bound: two-sided empirical Bernstein, summed over independent compiled settings
confidence.implementation: WordFunctional.radius(..., delta=0.05, family=2, bound='eb', rounds=17, method='bonferroni')

protocol.endpoint_sampling: independent fixed schedules, not cumulative; every schedule is determined before its outcomes
protocol.seed_derivation: numpy.random.SeedSequence(root, spawn_key=(protocol_index, endpoint_or_replica_index)); namespaces and roots are disjoint

matrix_reconstruction.source: exact Pauli means passed through each compiled setting's signed readout map

covariance_audit.cells: both estimators crossed with both protocol endpoints
covariance_audit.prediction: mean covariance-aware WordFunctional.variance from the grouped caches
covariance_audit.empirical: ddof=1 variance of the 1000 Ritz-functional estimates

protocol.device_costing: At a certified effective-shot endpoint, apply each frozen card's fidelity inflation and routing multipliers to the compiled per-setting resource vector, then report logical runtime separately per card.

blocking_gates: both endpoint plans reproduce the frozen partition, signed readouts, setting counts, and resource sums
both exact S and H reconstructions satisfy the 5e-13 maximum-entry tolerance
every sampled schedule equals the preregistered coefficient-range allocation and total budget
every pooled word's setting weights sum to one, every reported variance is nonnegative, and all four covariance-audit ratios lie in [0.8, 1.2]
acceptance.certified_endpoint_rule: first preregistered total-shot endpoint whose empirical-Bernstein Ritz radius is no larger than the frozen stochastic radius; otherwise right-censored above 4294967296
acceptance.shot_efficiency_go_rule: fully_commuting certified endpoint is finite and no greater than 0.5 times the QWC certified endpoint
acceptance.device_reporting_rule: report logical runtime separately per card for the same comparison; no cross-card or hardware-universal winner
acceptance.failure_rule: any blocking-gate failure suppresses the efficiency verdict and records a protocol failure

required: per-endpoint shot vector, empirical-Bernstein radius, estimate error, and censoring status
certified endpoint and total physical shots per protocol
compiled gate and depth ledgers plus per-card inflated runtime
all four predicted and empirical covariance-audit variances and their ratios
maximum exact S and H reconstruction errors
shot-efficiency and card-specific decisions with failures kept visible
reporting.evidence_boundary: oracle-sampled exact-state measurement capability on one frozen BeH2/JW bank; not state-preparation, hardware, noise-model, mitigation, mapping, or instance-independent evidence

claim_boundary: This configuration contains no Phase 14b sample, radius, cost, crossing, decision, or covariance ratio. A later record may report only the frozen BeH2/JW QWC-versus-fully-commuting comparison under this allocator, confidence family, endpoint grid, covariance audit, reconstruction gate, and illustrative device cards. It may not change the word universe, functional, grouping, synthesis, accuracy target, delta, schedules, seeds, acceptance rules, or inherited Phase 14a and R3 evidence.
